column1: # BrkSelector keys are the second byte after BRK. The IRQ/BRK dispatcher ($0F/$1F:$C408, byte-identical in both fixed banks) routes low nibbles $3 and $B on this byte alone, so every selector in those two families is listed.
# Default BRK services (other low nibbles) return through $C38B or $C3CE, whose RTS resumes at BRK+3, unless a BrkService row names a handler that advances the stacked return address.
# BrkService keys are bank:entry, where bank = ((selector >> 3) & 1) * $10 + (selector >> 4) and entry = first byte; first bytes >= $80 take the $C3CE pointer path and always resume at BRK+3.
# JsrInline keys are bank:target for a JSR whose callee advances its own stacked return address past inline bytes.
